import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

task = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
dll = pathlib.Path('/home/ltlly/.local/share/Steam/steamapps/common/Slay the Spire 2/data_sts2_linuxbsd_x86_64/sts2.dll')
types = [
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Relics.BeltBuckle',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Relics.ReptileTrinket',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Relics.Sozu',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.Relics.WhiteBeastStatue',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Nodes.Potions.NPotionContainer',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Nodes.Potions.NPotionPopup',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Nodes.Multiplayer.NMultiplayerPlayerState',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Nodes.CommonUi.NTopBar',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Multiplayer.Game.PeerInput.HoveredModelTracker',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.GameActions.DiscardPotionGameAction',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Entities.Models.DeterministicModelComparer',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Combat.CombatState',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Runs.RunState',
    'MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.Models.PotionModel',
]
source_dir = task / 'native-sources'
source_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def extract(name):
    command = ['/home/ltlly/.dotnet/tools/ilspycmd', '-t', name, str(dll)]
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, timeout=60)
    file = source_dir / (name.removeprefix('MegaCrit.Sts2.Core.') + '.cs')
    file.write_bytes(result.stdout)
    file.with_suffix('.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
    return {'type': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': result.returncode,
            'path': str(file), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest(),
            'bytes': len(result.stdout)}

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    results = list(pool.map(extract, types))
output = {'dll': str(dll), 'dllSha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
          'purpose': 'Read IL only; no gameplay execution or performance measurement.',
          'sources': results}
(task / 'source-extraction.json').write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'types': len(results), 'failed': [r for r in results if r['returncode'] != 0]}))
assert all(r['returncode'] == 0 and r['bytes'] > 0 for r in results)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time

base = Path.cwd()
task = base / '.local/tool-tasks/potion-inventory-proof-20261006'
host = base / '.local/tool-tasks/intrinsic-card-value-20261006/updated-harness/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
phase = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 'exact'
assert phase in ['exact', 'handoff']
dll = task / ('observer-build' if phase == 'exact' else 'handoff-observer-build') / 'CombatSolver.dll'
request = Path('/home/ltlly/Code/nmslmod/CombatSolver-perf-20261001/.local/veryhigh-dop16/frozen-corpus/requests/dev-00-ironclad-elite.json')
out = task / ('diagnostic-dev00' if phase == 'exact' else 'diagnostic-handoff-dev00')
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cmd = ['dotnet', str(host), '--request', str(request), '--label', 'potion-inventory-proof-'+phase+'-dev00',
       '--out', str(out), '--profile', 'VeryHigh', '--dop', '16', '--budget-ms', '300000',
       '--search-mode', 'Coordinator', '--nodes', '500000', '--beam', '135',
       '--card-branches', '72', '--pile-branches', '42', '--hand-branches', '54',
       '--enable-no-gc-region', '--no-gc-region-budget-gigabytes', '16',
       '--use-portfolio', '--production-budget']
env = os.environ.copy()
env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
for key in ['DOTNET_PerfMapEnabled', 'COMPlus_PerfMapEnabled']:
    env.pop(key, None)
plan = {'command': cmd, 'outerTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'diagnosticOnly': True,
        'noCandidateDeleted': True, 'notPerformanceAcceptance': True,
        'dllSha256': hashlib.sha256(dll.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        'requestSha256': hashlib.sha256(request.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(out / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan, indent=2) + '\n')
start = time.monotonic()
with (out / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
    process = subprocess.Popen(cmd, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    try:
        code = process.wait(timeout=120)
        status = 'Completed' if code == 0 else 'Failed'
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        process.kill()
        process.wait()
        code = process.returncode
        status = 'TimeoutNoRetry'
record = {'phase': phase, 'status': status, 'exitCode': code, 'launcherWallSeconds': time.monotonic()-start,
          'plan': plan, 'resultPath': str(out / 'result.json')}
if status == 'Completed':
    result = json.loads((out / 'result.json').read_text())
    for key in ['wallSeconds', 'peakProcessWorkingSetBytes', 'comparisonQuality', 'budget',
                'solverMetrics', 'pruneCounters', 'timeBoundaryObserved']:
        record[key] = result[key]
    record['rootStampSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(result['rootContinuationStamp'].encode()).hexdigest()
    record['policy'] = json.loads((out / 'search-policy.json').read_text())
    record['resultSha256'] = hashlib.sha256((out / 'result.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    rows = []
    for path in (out / 'logs').rglob('process.jsonl'):
        for line in path.read_text().splitlines():
            message = json.loads(line)['Message']
            if 'POTION_INVENTORY_OPPORTUNITY ' not in message:
                continue
            fields = dict(token.split('=', 1) for token in message.split('POTION_INVENTORY_OPPORTUNITY ')[1].split())
            row = {k: v if k == 'key' else float(v) if k.endswith('_ms') else int(v)
                   for k, v in fields.items()}
            rows.append(row)
    record['opportunityRows'] = rows
(task / ('diagnostic-summary.json' if phase == 'exact' else 'diagnostic-handoff-summary.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k: record.get(k) for k in ['status','exitCode','comparisonQuality','timeBoundaryObserved','opportunityRows']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
assert status == 'Completed', 'Terminal result retained; do not retry unchanged timeout.'
